_doc: Route map for part ingestion (RESEARCH.md R22). One row per source, in the order tried when a part is looked up by name. `adapter` names a class in sources.py (fetch code only); everything else is data: where to look, how to extract, what the prompt engine is told for this site. `needs`: environment variables without which the source is skipped (and reported).

electronics.name: adafruit
electronics.prompt_instructions: Focus on Adafruit pinout headers, STEMMA QT ports and supply voltages. Pin names as printed on the board.

electronics.name: sparkfun
electronics.prompt_instructions: Focus on the pin labels of the breakout and its Qwiic connectors; take voltages from the specifications.

electronics.name: pololu
electronics.prompt_instructions: Focus on the pinout table and the connector of the motor or driver; servos: signal, power, ground.

electronics.name: seeed
electronics.prompt_instructions: Grove modules have a 4-pin Grove connector (GND, VCC, and two signals); name the signals as on the board.

electronics.name: mouser
electronics.prompt_instructions: The record is Mouser's API data: use the manufacturer part number and attributes; pins from the package.

electronics.name: digikey
electronics.prompt_instructions: The record is DigiKey's API data: use the manufacturer part number and parameters; pins from the package.

lego.name: rebrickable
lego.best_for: every official part: number, name, category, colours, element IDs
lego.prompt_instructions: LEGO part from Rebrickable data. part_type_id is 'lego-<part number>'. Studs on top and stud receptacles underneath as grids (1 stud = 8 mm, 1 plate = 3.2 mm high); every other connection point as a port (pin, pin-hole, axle, axle-hole, clip, bar, ball, socket, hinge). Rotation symmetry 180 for a 2x4 brick, 90 for a 2x2.

lego_sets.name: booklet
lego_sets.best_for: sets Rebrickable does not have yet

lego_models.name: ldraw-omr
lego_models.best_for: fan-made 3D models of official sets: exact build graph by code (Path A)

lego_text_guides.name: lego-audio-braille
lego_text_guides.best_for: LEGO's official text instructions for screen readers (about 115 recent sets)

lego_text_guides.name: bricks-for-the-blind
lego_text_guides.best_for: volunteer text instructions for blind builders (about 700 sets)
